source: Tevatron/msmarco-passage-corpus (huggingface.co), same corpus and stride sampling as bench/src/msmarco_index.rs; every document indexed as a PreTokenizedString built directly from strand_lexical::analyzer::analyze_lucene_en_word_only's own output, so tantivy's own tokenizer/stopword/stemmer chain is never invoked — the vocabulary, doc frequencies, term frequencies, and position counts are identical to what STRAND's own postings/positions blobs would index for the same corpus subset.
